label: champ_0230_system_01
text: Are you ready to face Poppy of the Elite Four?

label: champ_0230_steel_01a
text: It’s so cool you made it this far! But this is where\nyou say bye-bye, mister![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_steel_01b
text: It’s so cool you made it this far! But this is where\nyou say bye-bye, miss![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_steel_02
text: All my Pokémon are super tough![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_steel_03
text: Your weak attacks won’t work on them at all!\nThey’ll bounce right off—you’ll see![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_steel_04
text: I can’t wait for you to meet my friends, so...\nhere they come![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_steel_05
text: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaah! I wanted to take revenge\non you, Rika![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_ground_01
text: Pretty sure you mean “take revenge FOR” me,\nsquirt. Don’t think I did anything wrong by you.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0230_ground_02
text: Hate to say it, but you lost, Poppy. Better call the\nnext guy![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0230_steel_06
text: Oh, that’s right! I haven’t had to do this in a\nlong time![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0230_ground_03
text: That’s two of the Elite Four down—but you’ve\ngot another two to go, so hang in there![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0230_steel_08
text: Mr. Larry’s real strong, y’know! Like, reeeal\nstrong![VAR 0x0114(0014)]
